correctness.rationale: An indexed circular word containing 00 has lexicographically minimal rotation starting 00, while at alternating position 2 a 01 zero-start rotation is smaller, so coincidence requires strictly positive zero gaps. For positive gaps a<b, the first mismatch is at one-based position a+2; the shorter gap wins both lex/alternating orders precisely when a is odd. With a unique minimum odd gap the common chosen rotation is forced. For k=2 count unequal gap pairs with odd smaller gap to obtain z^5/((1−z)(1−z^4)); for k=3 tied odd minima occur as (a,a,b) and still coincide, yielding z^7/((1−z)^2(1−z^6)). For fixed k≥2, anchoring a unique positive odd minimum gap gives generating function z^(3k−1)/((1−z)^(k−1)(1−z^(2k))); tied minima are O_k(n^(k−2)), yielding C_{n,k}=n^(k−1)/(2k!)+O(n^(k−2)), half the standard primitive necklace count. At k/n→α>0, cyclic 00 avoidance is ≤(n/(n−k)) exp(−k²/n) fraction of indexed words and nonprimitive words are exponentially negligible, giving exponential coincidence decay (zero when k>n/2). Independently enumerated ordinary and alternating minimum full rotation classes for 2≤n≤15,k≤3. Exact counts only k≤3; for k≥4 only leading profile.
